# Scripts — `scripts/*`, `.githooks/*`

File header and why-comments as in `docs.mdc`, plus:

These are glue a reader steps through top to bottom, not app modules — narrate the whole run, not just the odd bits. Every code line or small block gets a `#` / `//` line above it saying what that step does, plus why when it isn't obvious: `set -euo pipefail`, the repo-root dance, each guard clause, each loop, each `aws` / `git` call. Shell, Python, and build `.mjs` under these paths all follow this.

Stay terse — one line per step, overflow to a paragraph after a blank line as everywhere else. This is the one place line-by-line narration is wanted; app code stays at the why-only bar in `docs.mdc`.
